# jamfplatform_pro_user (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro **inventory user** record (a person in *Users → User Inventory*) by ID or by exact username. Exactly one of `id` or `username` must be supplied. This is the user record that devices and groups are scoped against — it is **not** a Jamf Pro admin account (see `jamfplatform_pro_account` for those).

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Jamf Pro privilege | Scoped name |
|---|---|
| Read User | `users:read` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_user" "example_by_id" {
  id = "42"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_user" "example_by_username" {
  username = "jsmith"
}

output "user_example_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_user.example_by_id
}

output "user_example_by_username" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_user.example_by_username
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Jamf Pro user ID. Mutually exclusive with `username`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `username` (String) **"Username"** in the Jamf Pro admin UI (exact match, case-insensitive). Mutually exclusive with `id`.

### Read-Only

- `custom_photo_url` (String) Custom photo URL for this user, when `enable_custom_photo_url` is set.
- `email_address` (String) **"Email Address"** in the Jamf Pro admin UI.
- `enable_custom_photo_url` (Boolean) Whether a custom photo URL is used for this user instead of the Gravatar derived from the email address.
- `full_name` (String) **"Full Name"** in the Jamf Pro admin UI.
- `managed_apple_id` (String) **"Managed Apple ID"** in the Jamf Pro admin UI.
- `phone_number` (String) **"Phone Number"** in the Jamf Pro admin UI.
- `position` (String) **"Position"** in the Jamf Pro admin UI.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
